title: Carbonda CFR 707 gravel bike

takeaways.text: The package includes fork, thru-axles, seatpost, spare derailleur hanger, bar and stem, and many accessory mounts; the headset costs extra, and the threaded bottom bracket is BSA.
Brake mounting surfaces sometimes need facing to remove paint before the calipers sit flat; he faced them with a tool.
The frame is set up natively for 160 mm rotors front and rear.

disclosure: Owner build video; he says he has built several of these frames for friends. No sponsorship is stated.
summary: Contents and build walkthrough of a custom-painted Carbonda CFR707 gravel frameset.
